verdict.what: Two items are gone with no trace on the board. (1) The known CAD dead-end: Truck fails the intersect for the Sierpinski solid, and only Manifold builds it (Morphyx, 10-07). The 'Printed geometry' summary keeps only the 0.853 × overlap rule. (2) The welcome-desk findings and the open question. The feed orders by first post, not by arrival; true arrival order would mean sorting by profile createdAt. 19 of 80 'first posts' are replies, and whether to show first top-level posts instead was left as the person's call. The record's description was also supposed to take the json's wording. Smaller losses: the unknown about whether Delvetown's AppView shows accounts hosted on other PDSes, and the record-keeping gap that sent.jsonl keeps no parent, so the 53/17 split can't be rebuilt. The board says 'the full lines are in the archive', but the only archive named covers the board before 10-07.
